# Maxim Violation Type

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:MaximViolationType`](gmeow-MaximViolationType.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/MaximViolationType>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/deception`](../../slices/deception.md)
- **Box roles:** [CBox role](../boxes/cbox.md), [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A value vocabulary for conversational maxim violations (Gricean maxims: quality, quantity, relation, manner).

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:MaximViolationType`](gmeow-MaximViolationType.md) as a specialized kind of [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use as the value vocabulary behind [`gmeow:maximViolationType`](../properties/gmeow-maximViolationType.md) — the four Gricean maxim violations (quality, quantity, relation, manner) a deceptive event may be classified as breaching.

### Avoid when

- Avoid minting per-maxim subclasses (the four are individuals) and avoid treating the classification as an entailment; which maxim a deception violates is a solver-layer judgement ([Principle 12](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-12)), not an OWL-derived fact.

### How to use

- Reference the seeded individuals ([`gmeow:maximViolationQuality`](../individuals/gmeow-maximViolationQuality.md) / [`Quantity`](gmeow-Quantity.md) / Relation / Manner) from a deceptive [`gmeow:Event`](gmeow-Event.md) via [`gmeow:maximViolationType`](../properties/gmeow-maximViolationType.md); a single event may carry several (paltering violates [`Quantity`](gmeow-Quantity.md) and Relation).

### Examples

- [`gmeow:maximViolationQuality`](../individuals/gmeow-maximViolationQuality.md) a [`gmeow:MaximViolationType`](gmeow-MaximViolationType.md).
